name: Judith Manouchehri
office: Beverly Hills Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Judith Manouchehri is the president of the Beverly Hills Unified School District Board of Education and was first elected in 2022. She is a real estate attorney and a graduate of BHUSD. She backed a resolution to combat antisemitism through education and remembrance programming. She voted to approve a partnership with Special Olympics Southern California to launch a Unified Champion Schools program. She says districtwide scores increased 4% in English, 5% in math, and 9% in science during the past year. Her candidate statement says she wants to continue raising academic standards and modernizing schools.
